title: Balloon-popping activity sparks false shooting alarm at Bohol school

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — A classroom activity involving the bursting of balloons triggered a false shooting alarm at Holy Name University (HNU) in Barangay Dampas here on Thursday evening, Sept. 24, prompting police to conduct a security sweep of the campus. Tagbilaran City police said they received a report of an alleged shooting at around 6:31 p.m. and immediately responded, under the leadership of Lt.Col. Joey Mallare Bicoy, officer-in-charge of the station. Police said no shooting incident had occurred. Initial investigation showed that fourth-year BS Biology students in Room 407 on the fourth floor heard a series of bursting sounds […]...
